# Real-read check on computational mixtures of GIAB HG002 + HG003 (auto-generated by scripts/giab_mixture_check.py)

Illumina 60x reads of two real cell lines, thinned and added at a chosen HG003 fraction f; chr20:1-30 Mb; copy-neutral, purity 1. x uses the observed class VAFs, the mean depth and the beta-binomial rho fitted to the drawn counts. Not a tumour and not a physical mixture.

## Pooled summary

- Controls: 126 false splits in 240 single-class runs (52%); the x >= 1 screen (rho assumed 0.02) keeps 1 of them.
- Two-cluster cells with x < 1 (12 cells, 360 runs): 204 splits, the screen keeps 3.
- Two-cluster cells with x >= 1 (4 cells, 120 runs): 120 splits, the screen keeps 75.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, all 16 cells: RMSE 0.255, bias (observed - predicted) +0.156.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, x >= 0.6: RMSE 0.134, bias (observed - predicted) +0.068.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, x < 0.6: RMSE 0.379, bias (observed - predicted) +0.303.
